supplier_price_scope: historical per-row CNY unit prices from the original official CSV, split peak/off-peak; no current-price backfill
maintainer_statement: online DeepSeek pricing uses OpenRouter DeepSeek prices
manifest_scope_note: Account is a stable SHA256 pseudonym qualified by the exact selected micro-one-api Key name; it does not claim the provider account is otherwise unused. No supplier project is invented. Key mask and account fingerprint provenance remain in provider-export.json.
mapping_note: Bounds use the existing credential observation and the later production revision-4 observation. They are an observed span only; no full-period source coverage is asserted, and complete=false with empty coverage evidence remains.
usage_import_note: All five normalized bucket columns are empty because the official CSV explicitly supplies only three token types; unproven cache creation buckets are not invented as zeros. Exact three-bucket/day agreement remains independently archived.
preflight_boundary: A CLI preview over an exact private owner DB snapshot validates real stored event digests; it is not a live production import and uses no synthetic local-attempts.
production_write_scope: Existing authenticated IAM Billing owner report/run append only; no user ledger, price, gate, credential or permission mutation.
